title: Benchmarks · Teleion Fabric · Teleion Labs
description: Plain results from recorded runs on Teleion Fabric: repository indexing, zero-shim memory reuse, 256-worker queue runs, Muse Glimmer 30B evaluations, and second-worker checks.

blocks.title: Benchmarks
blocks.lead: What we tested on Teleion Fabric, how well it performed, and what tradeoffs matter. Setup details, confidence intervals, adapter comparisons, and raw records live on one technical page: [See how we measured this →](/benchmarks/methodology/).
